name: Dating Killmulator
source:
A new type of dark humour VN game about dating popular guys, nice guys, and serial killers!

Play as a university student, going about her daily life surrounded by quirky and surreal characters. The game offers three love routes: Cain Montgomery, Abel Conti, and Florian Seth—all of them full of secrets and crazy stories awaiting you.

[From [url=https://unaiestavillo.itch.io/datingkillmulator]Itch[/url]]
translation:
一款新型黑色幽默VN游戏，讲述与受欢迎的男人、好男人和连环杀手约会的游戏！

扮演一名大学生，她的日常生活被古怪和超现实的角色所包围。游戏提供了三种爱情路线：凯恩·蒙哥马利、阿贝尔·孔蒂和弗洛里安·塞斯——所有路线都充满秘密和疯狂的故事等待着你。

[来自[url=https://unaiestavillo.itch.io/datingkillmulator]Itch[/url]]
